prompt:
Character ANIMATION SHEET for a 2D life-simulation game set in Huambo, Angola. The two attached images show the two characters (the man and the woman): keep EXACTLY the same faces, hair, skin tone, clothes, colours and proportions. Draw a strict grid of 6 ROWS and 18 COLUMNS, every cell the same size, one full-body figure per cell (feet visible, same baseline and same scale in every cell), transparent background, nothing touching the neighbouring cells, no text, no grid lines.
ROW 1: the MAN seen from the FRONT (facing the viewer). ROW 2: the MAN in PROFILE walking to the RIGHT. ROW 3: the MAN seen from the BACK (walking away). ROW 4: the WOMAN from the FRONT. ROW 5: the WOMAN in PROFILE walking to the RIGHT. ROW 6: the WOMAN from the BACK.
In every row, the 18 columns are: columns 1-8 = a smooth WALK CYCLE (8 frames: contact, down, passing, up, contact with the other foot, down, passing, up); column 9 = standing still; column 10 = sitting on an invisible chair; columns 11-14 = working (4 frames, hands busy at waist height); columns 15-18 = waving hello (4 frames). Natural Angolan everyday look, same isometric-style shading and light (from top-left) as the references, slightly high camera.
